LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrix.label: brood matrix
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrix.description: Grows up to four children to age thirteen at eighty times the normal rate, consuming hemogel. Children receive skills, passions, traits, and genes from a living donor according to the inheritance settings. The donor ages rapidly and dies when their remaining lifetime is exhausted.\n\nOnly outsiders can serve as donors; pawns accepted by the flesh colony or grown in flesh are unsuitable. Without a donor, growth stops. Depleting the food reserve kills the capsule occupants.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixEmbryo.label: brood matrix embryo
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixEmbryo.description: An immature brood organ that will grow into a brood matrix.
